verdict.rationale: Codex documents checking skills into the repository: it scans `.agents/skills` from the working directory up to the repo root, and teams can check in skills scoped to a folder. Copy-installed skills also land as plain files in `.agents/skills`, so skill changes reach the team only through commits they control. However, nothing documents version pinning or a lockfile for marketplace plugins, and published plugins' MCP server changes are picked up automatically once they pass automated checks, which is exactly the behind-the-back update the story wants to avoid. missing for 10: documented version pinning for marketplace plugins/skills, a lockfile mechanism, a way to opt out of automatic MCP-backed plugin updates, independent corroboration.
